shots.title: Mochi donuts at Mikiko
shots.tip: New at Bridgeport Village. Set the box on the counter, shoot straight down, then one close up. Ask the counter first, and keep other customers out of the frame.

shots.title: Rainy day by the big windows
shots.tip: On a rainy day, shoot from inside toward the glass. Overhead lights off so the windows glow.

shots.title: Cozy in the lounge
shots.tip: Blanket, mug, soft light. Get low and shoot across the sofas.

shots.title: Game night
shots.tip: Cue ball mid roll, window seat to the side. Hands only is perfect.

shots.title: Morning workout
shots.tip: Early light, rack in focus. A 5 second slow pan makes a great reel.

shots.title: Clubroom coffee bar glow
shots.tip: Shoot at dusk with the shelves lit. Add a latte on the counter.

shots.title: Model home, holiday ready
shots.tip: Throw blanket, a flameless candle, a small tree. Stand in the doorway, phone at chest height.

shots.title: Kitchen details
shots.tip: Close ups sell: the pendant light, the counter, a bowl of fruit.

shots.title: Montage at golden hour
shots.tip: Last hour before sunset. Stand across the street to fit the whole building.

notice.title: Tap what you show on the walk
points: In Tour mode, tap each amenity as you show it (pool and spa, sky lounge, golf simulator and the rest). It turns green with a ✓.
Everything you tap lands on your desk list, so your My day email now says what you showed them.
Rival prices and specials now show the day each one was checked.
